description: This file defines the Menu model class for the Opencart admin system, providing methods to create, read, update, and delete menu records and their descriptions in the database.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Model class for managing menu records and descriptions within the Opencart admin module.

methods.name: addMenu
methods.description: Creates a new menu record in the database and adds descriptions for different languages.

methods.name: editMenu
methods.description: Updates an existing menu record and its descriptions based on menu ID.

methods.name: deleteMenu
methods.description: Deletes a menu record by its ID and removes associated descriptions.

methods.name: deleteMenuByCode
methods.description: Deletes menu records identified by their code.

methods.name: getMenu
methods.description: Retrieves a menu record by its ID, including description for the current language.

methods.name: getMenuByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a menu record by its code, including description for the current language.

methods.name: getMenus
methods.description: Retrieves all menu records, indexed by their code.

methods.name: getTotalMenus
methods.description: Returns the total count of menu records.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a menu in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific menu ID.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific language across all menus.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific menu ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific language ID.
